name: China economy
summary: China property investment fell 21.6% in January to October and new-home sales 14.3%; property slump persists
state: Real estate development investment fell 21.6% year on year in January to October, with the value of new commercial building sales down 14.3% and floor space sold down 13.7% (NBS, 17 Nov). The property slump and developer distress that set Watch continue. No hard landing below 3% growth, wider financial contagion or sharp tightening of capital controls was found as of 24 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: A prolonged property slump in China tends to weigh on demand for commodities and on exporters selling into China, and on the finances of local governments and developers there.
rubric_hit: Watch: continued property-developer distress (investment −21.6% y/y Jan–Oct); no hard landing or contagion for Alert

sources.title: National Bureau of Statistics of China — Investment in real estate development from January to October 2026

why: China is the world's factory and the biggest marginal buyer of commodities; a hard landing would ripple through every supply chain.
drivers: Property sector, local-government debt, exports and tariffs, deflation, stimulus.

rubric.alert: Hard landing (growth < 3%), financial contagion, or capital controls tightened sharply.
rubric.watch: Deflation, renewed property-developer defaults, or growth clearly below target.
rubric.normal: Growth near official target, stable property sales, no financial contagion.
